user.title: Add Mobius XR15
user.description: Enter the BLE MAC address of your Radion XR15w G5 Pro (device identity) and the URL of the XR15 bridge (xr15_server.py) that talks to it over Bluetooth.

error.invalid_mac: Enter a MAC address in the form AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the XR15 bridge at this URL. Check that xr15_server.py is running on the host.
